required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Open/free source snapshot exists locally, is hash-bound, and satisfies source separation policy.

required_source.requirement: Acquire and hash UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c Study from https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds000030.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Target table is locked before scoring and hidden fields do not leak into model selection.

required_target.requirement: Resting-state BOLD time series are transformed into a locked atlas connectivity matrix; heldout subject edge values stay hidden until predictions are materialized.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: OC prediction/scoring rule is preregistered before target unsealing.

required_model.requirement: Fit a training-only nuisance-adjusted ridge/graph prior from visible subject covariates and training-subject connectivity structure, then predict heldout subject edge vectors once.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Incumbent comparator is scored on the same held-out targets.

required_comparator.requirement: predict each heldout edge by the training-only mean for the same atlas edge and stratum

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: OC residual advantage exceeds preregistered materiality threshold under uncertainty.

required_uncertainty.metric: edge-wise absolute residual and subject-level RMSE over heldout edge vectors
required_uncertainty.requirement: subject bootstrap plus motion-quality stratified conformal residual envelope

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Negative controls and falsifiers are declared and replayed without post-hoc adjustment.

required_falsifier.requirement: Heldout connectivity edges leak into training, dataset hashes drift, fewer than 20 subjects are scored, or training-mean comparator ties or beats the model within uncertainty.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Clean replay regenerates the evidence pack hash and result verdict.
